name: nemotron-3.5-asr-0.6b-325mb
affiliation: Not affiliated with or endorsed by NVIDIA. Community quantization of a NVIDIA base model.

size_budget.note: 325 MB is a project-internal target, revised 220 -> 295 -> 320 -> 325 MB during development. It is not an external standard and not a property of the base model. The delivered artifact sits 1.41 MB inside this line and 3.59 MB above the earlier 320 MB line.

format.histogram_note: This is a result, not a recipe. GGUF metadata exposes per-tensor types to anyone who loads the file; it does not say how the assignment was found.

runtime.required_flag_reason: Default n-ctx equals the model maximum; batch mode then over-allocates and throughput collapses. 1024 is the measured working value.
runtime.rtfx_condition: AMD EPYC 9K65, 4 threads, 20 clips / 188.6 s audio / 12.83 s wall
runtime.gpu_support: none — TQ1_0 has no CUDA kernel; Metal rejects the type. CPU and Vulkan are the paths.

eval.metric: WER for 14 locales, CER for zh-CN / ja-JP / ko-KR

provenance.note: The published file is byte-identical to the artifact that produced the numbers above. sha256 is checked before and after upload.
provenance.export_determinism: The export pipeline is NOT deterministic: two runs of the same configuration produced byte-different files of identical size. Only the hash above denotes the evaluated artifact.
